m.bngl: # FluBNF SIHRS, TWO-STRAIN (A/B) MIN, the PF two-strain variant. Two
# independent SIHRS circuits over the same population N, in the same trim as
# SIHRS_pop_min.bngl: no reseeding term, no semi-annual harmonic (the B
# circuit carries two-wave structure mechanistically). Design:
# Fitted (7): ReffA, ReffB, eps1, phi1A, phi1B, mult, r
#   strain-A share of initial infections, from the season's first NREVSS.
# Channels: NHSN admissions (NB) on the weekly increment of the combined
# H_Cum, and A_share (NREVSS typed positives, binomial); mult cancels in
# A_share, so the two channels identify different things.
ReffA   ReffA__FREE    # strain-A BASE reproduction number: harmonic-neutral,
# at the initial susceptible fraction s0. NOT the
ReffB   ReffB__FREE    # strain-B, same convention; typically smaller, LATER phase
eps1    eps1__FREE     # seasonal amplitude, SHARED across strains
phi1A   phi1A__FREE    # strain-A week of peak transmissibility (circular)
phi1B   phi1B__FREE    # strain-B phase: the spring-wave mechanism
rho     0.02        # FIXED IHR, shared for the draft (refinement: rhoB=c*rho)
mult    mult__FREE     # ascertainment, shared: one reporting system.
# OBSERVATION-ONLY, never in a reaction rule
r       r__FREE        # NB dispersion, admissions channel
pi      3.141592653589793  # avoid BNGL _pi(): bngsim codegen emits M_PI()
s0      0.85     # applied to BOTH circuits (independent co-circulation)
a0      0.7500    # A-share of i0: known data, never fitted
# Each circuit spans the whole population N: infection with one type
# confers no protection against the other.
# ONE '_Cum' observable: the engine's integrated mode globs the first
# '_Cum' column, so only the COMBINED accumulator may carry the suffix.
